caveat: Adaptive development after inspecting prior xG experiments on these seasons. These periods are not an untouched holdout. Existing frozen xg-paired-1 forecasts must not change.
sources: Existing pinned consistent Understat league-summary snapshot plus public ESPN club fixture calendars. Pin normalized event bytes and source-response hashes before evaluating. Verify EPL identities and scores against the original Football-Data results; report scope/truncation/missing-competition coverage.
dataFence: Every fitted observation and workload event is dated strictly before target date minus one calendar day. Base probabilities are rolling out-of-sample forecasts; outcome labels never enter their own features or correction fit.
features: (home rest capped at 14 days - away rest capped at 14 days) / 7
-(home games in preceding 7 days - away games) / 3
-(home games in preceding 14 days - away games) / 5
missingness: Only complete explicitly verified competition coverage supplies numeric rest/counts. Unknown coverage produces no correction and preserves the exact baseline distribution. Unknown match minutes never become zero extra time. Extra-time information is diagnostic only in this experiment.
correction: Three shared coefficients beta in [-0.75, 0.75]; delta = dot(beta,features); softmax(log(baseline probabilities)+[delta,0,-delta]). Fit weighted cross entropy plus ridge from strictly earlier out-of-sample rows. No extra intercept or team parameters.
selectionRule: Select minimum validation log loss among challengers improving fixed xG baseline log loss without reducing top-outcome accuracy on the same eligible fixtures. Save selection and plan/data/implementation hashes before evaluating only the chosen challenger on audit seasons. Retain baseline if none qualifies.
auditGate: Require improved audit Brier and log loss, and no reduction in audit accuracy. Report day-clustered paired confidence intervals and current-season monitoring regardless of direction. Historical gains do not authorize default promotion or replacement of previously frozen forecasts.
